import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load and aggregate revenue by region
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
revenue = df.groupby('region')['revenue'].sum()
target = 100000
remaining = target - revenue.sum()

# Pie slices show regional revenue and the unfilled portion of the target
labels = list(revenue.index) + ['Remaining to target']
values = revenue.tolist() + [remaining]
colors = ['#4C78A8', '#F58518', '#D9D9D9']

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 6))
ax.pie(values, labels=labels, colors=colors, startangle=90, autopct=lambda p: f'{p:.1f}%' if p > 0 else '')
ax.set_title('Regional revenue as share of $100,000 target')
ax.axis('equal')
plt.tight_layout()
